title: Biomass-derived carbon materials for sustainable energy applications: a comprehensive review
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01393J, Review Article
Tasmina Khandaker, Tasniqul Islam, Ananya Nandi, Md Al Amin Mia Anik, Md. Shihab Hossain, Md. Kamrul Hasan, Muhammad Sarwar Hossain
Biomass-derived carbon materials (BDCMs) represent a versatile and sustainable solution for a range of energy generation and storage applications, owing to their tunable porosity, high surface area, and excellent electrochemical properties.
